# Fonts in this folder

| Files | Typeface |
|---|---|
| `oxanium-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | Oxanium |
| `exo-2-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | Exo 2 |
| `inter-latin-*.woff2` | Inter |
| `poppins-latin-*.woff2` | Poppins |

These are Latin-subset web font files. All four typefaces are published by their authors
under the SIL Open Font License, version 1.1
(https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/). Copyright belongs to
those authors.

Still to do before any formal release: the licence asks that its text and the copyright
notice travel with the fonts, so add each typeface's `OFL.txt` to this folder. The exact
source of these files was not re-checked when this note was written.
